topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: Well, now, hear this! A man from far-off lands, no less, found himself tangled in misfortunes. Seems his sky-boat, as he called it, refused to fly as planned. The fair winds were willing, but the iron beast was not. So he sat, waiting, while time slipped through his fingers like grains of sand. His face was long as a donkey’s, for there was an important gathering he needed to reach, or so he said. Saints above, missing such a thing over a stubborn machine! Still, what can you do but pray for better fortune and hope the saints take pity on us all?
